part.text:
Fixed. The issue was that the `0` width flag applied zero-fill to inf/nan. Two changes:

- `include/fmt/core.h` — `specs_setter::on_zero()` now only sets `align::numeric` when no explicit alignment was given, preserving user-specified `<`/`>`/`^`.
- `include/fmt/format.h` — `write_nonfinite()` takes the specs by value and replaces a `'0'` fill with a space, so non-finite values are space-padded (e.g. `"{:+06}"` on NaN now yields `"  +nan"` instead of `"00+nan"`).

Verified: `format-test` nan/infinity cases pass, and the full ctest suite (18/18) passes with no regressions.
